{{Quote|Because of my failure, my people lost their honor and accepted ''peez''&ndash;subjection to the infidels. They have been allowed to live like tame ''tso'asu'' on the weapon-world, with my betrothed among them.|An entry in Darth Vua's personal holocron|<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" />}}
'''Darth Vua''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Gender|male]] who was recruited by the [[One Sith]] as a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. Vua was a [[Slayers|slayer]] who fought during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I am a captive of the One Sith&ndash;heretics and outcasts even among the infidels. They have given me the outward appearance of an infidel, and awakened ''Jeedai'' thoughts inside my head. They say this is my ''true self''.|An entry in Darth Vua's personal holocron|<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" />}}
Darth Vua was a [[Gender|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Slayers|Slayer]] who was active during the concluding stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" /> Like all Slayers, Vua was bred from [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] grown from tissue samples taken from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that had been augmented and transformed by Yuuzhan Vong [[Shaper caste|shapers]] to serve [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane]] as elite warriors.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> At some stage, Vua became [[Marriage/Legends|bethrothed]] to [[Darth Vua's betrothed|another Yuuzhan Vong]]. Shortly prior to the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]] at the conclusion of the war,<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> Vua was dispatched<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" /> on the orders of Shimrra to fly a [[Slayer ship]]<ref name="TUF" /> [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] with the pathogen [[Alpha Red]] onto the living [[planet]] [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]]<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" /> in an attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] world.<ref name="TUF" /> However, Zonama Sekot used its [[Gravity/Legends|gravitic]] power to fling the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] away and Vua's mission was unsuccessful.<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" /> Soon afterward, the Yuuzhan Vong surrendered during a final battle over [[Coruscant/Legends|Yuuzhan'tar]]<ref name="TUF" /> and the surviving Vong, including Vua's bethrothed, were sent to live on Zonama Sekot.<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" />

Following the battle, Vua came to be regarded by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] population as analogous to one of the Yuuzhan Vong's enemy, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], as a lone [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who had taken on an entire weaponized world;<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" /> Skywalker having destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> In the aftermath of the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Slayer was captured by the [[One Sith]],<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" /> a resurgent [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]] active on the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref> and was forced to become a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], adopting the Sith name "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vua". The former-Slayer later created a [[Darth Vua's holocron|personal holocron]] in which he recorded his thoughts about his role in the defeat of the Yuuzhan Vong and forced recruitment by the Sith.<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I am ''not'' Luke Skywalker. I failed.|An entry in Darth Vua's personal holocron|<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" />}}
Darth Vua felt responsibility for the defeat of the Yuuzhan Vong, believing that it was because of his failure to destroy Zonama Sekot that his people were forced to surrender and settle on the living world. He also rejected the comparisons of him with Luke Skywalker because Skywalker had been victorious when he attacked the Death Star, whereas Vua had been defeated when he flew against Zonama Sekot.<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" />

Vua also believed that One Sith had tried to imprint [[Jeedai heresy|''Jeedai'']] thoughts inside his mind in an attempt to break him, but he maintained his resolve and refused to surrender to their way of thinking.<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This is an homage to the distinctive vibe of the New Jedi Order novels, and the way they challenged our ideas of identity and narrative structure. It was supposed to act as a thematic conclusion for the Yuuzhan Vong section, so if you have a copy of Warfare within reach, read chapter 19 and then jump straight in to this.|Paul R. Urquhart, in ''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'': Author's Cut, Part 12: Tales of the New Republic''|<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" />}}
Darth Vua was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] article [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'': Author's Cut, Part 12: Tales of the New Republic'']], an article in series by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] that published content written for the reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' that didn't make the final cut. Vua was to be referenced within a brief extract from his personal holocron written from an in-universe perspective and the subsequent publication of the content in ''Author{{'s}} Cut'' brought it into [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity. The extract references the events of the novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]'' which depicts the attempt by a Slayer ship to poison Zonama Sekot with Alpha Red, by establishing Vua as the vessel's pilot. Urquart intended for this piece to act as a conclusion to the Yuuzhan Vong section of the ''Essential Guide''.<ref name="Tales of the New Republic" />
